notes.title: Update Information Ver 1.04 (2022/2/28)
notes.content:
The following updates have been applied.

 - Fixed a bug related to Talent Points.
 - Fixed a bug in which "Teddy Bear" would sometimes not appear in the Craft list.
 - Fixed various bugs.

Note: For details about the bugs, please visit our official site.
https://blue-reflection.com/secondlight/us/updates.html#info
https://blue-reflection.com/secondlight/uk/updates.html#info

notes.title: About the bug fixes in Ver 1.03
notes.content:
In Ver 1.03, the bugs below were fixed.
 - In the data after clearing the main game, accumulating Talent Points for Ao becomes difficult.
 - There are instances when Talent Points are not awarded after completing Requests.
 - When a character is selected in FreeSpace, there are instances when the game appears to freeze.

Note: For details about the bugs, please visit our official site.
https://blue-reflection.com/secondlight/us/updates.html#info
https://blue-reflection.com/secondlight/uk/updates.html#info

We apologize for any inconveniences caused.
We hope you continue to enjoy playing BLUE REFLECTION: Second Light.

notes.title: Update Information Ver 1.03 (2022/1/24)
notes.content:
The following updates have been applied.

 - Corrected an issue in which, even if the "Big Puni" that appears in the DLC "Additional Map - Atelier Ryza Collab Dungeon" was defeated, "Big Puni" could not be placed in Photo Mode.
 - Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Update Information Ver 1.02 (2022/1/4)
notes.content:
The following updates have been applied.

 - Updated Photo Mode.
Note: Added the filter "8-bit".
Note: Added poses.
 - Improved compatibility with the new DLCs.
 - Made adjustments to accommodate the "Atelier Sophie 2" Early Purchase Joint Bonus.
 - Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Update Information Ver 1.01 (2021/11/23)
notes.content:
The following updates have been applied.

 - Updated Photo Mode.
Note: Some characters can now be changed into Reflectors.
Note: Added the filters "Hatching" and "Watercolor". 
Note: Added the Photo Frames "Postcard", "Camera Phone", and "Puzzle".
Note: Added poses.
 - Added the School Development Facility "Photo Studio".
 - Added a new Difficulty.
 - Corrected an issue in which processing would sometimes drop with certain environments.
 - Improved compatibility with the new DLCs.
 - Fixed various bugs.
